It is the end of a long story and beginning again. It is one of those “it worked out much better than anticipated” stories. It is a beautiful story and a great story, filled with happiness, fun, friendship, family, and love.

There are secrets, and mysteries to the storyline.

This story does not end here. It does not close doors to new stories. New creations, and new characters will come.

So, to all of you who joined in, in any way imaginable, from simple ‘Like’, and ‘Comment’, to sharing, and offering up your support – I thank you. This adventure has touched my life in a way that goes far beyond what words can do.

I hope that you will find something in the “Survival 03” mod for “Cube World”, that makes you happy, and fulfilled. For most of you, that will not be finding a love interest and building their home

I hope you find love in the places I have created. Love, being filled in by other community members, like these stunning figures, created by community member (and friend).

I’ve been on my way into the firehouses, looking through the closets, looking for things that I can actually use to save myself. I will try my best to find other gays, such as myself, so that we could be together like we once were while still living. I hope that when people hear of me, they will help me.

If I don’t know you or you don’t know me then, I’m sorry. So sorry. Everyone in this world is someone who hasn’t found their one true love, but some of us think we’re too young to tell others that aren’t us gays. But we can love as much as anyone. I am one of those gay men, and now this virus isn’t going to stop me from love. With my parents, I’m not a straight man, not a “normal” gay, but my parents have always accepted me. The only people if my parents know that I am gay are my father, my grandparents. I just moved with my parents while still living with me. Then they died. Me, my twin sister, and I went to their grave and said, “Remember, that we still love you”
